---
title: "Survey questions: competition"
description-meta: "Ask firms about their main market, how many competitors they face, how competition has changed and whether they can raise prices, using tested questions."
---

**In [year], which of the following was the main market in which this establishment sold its main product [or offered its main service]?**

- Local - main product [or service] sold mostly in same area where establishment is located
- National - main product [or service] sold mostly across the country where establishment is located
- International 

***

**How many competitors did this establishment’s main product [or service] face in this main market?**
*(Open numeric field)*

***

**Which of the following best describes this establishment’s main market?**

- The market is dominated by one firm
- The market is dominated by a few firms
- There is competition among many firms

***

**Over the last year, has the level of competition in this establishment’s main market increased, decreased, or stayed the same?**

- Increased
- Decreased
- Stayed the same

***

**Considering the main market for this establishment’s main product or service, can this establishment increase its prices more so than its competitors can without losing customers?**

- Yes
- No
- Prices regulated
- Prices are set by headquarters
